children: Nexus has scheduled a NEX supply unlock for November 2027. The release covers 1,116.67 billion NEX, equal to 1.86% of the token's circulating supply. The tokens are allocated to investors and members of the Nexus team.
Investors and team members gain access to NEX they could not sell while it was locked. Once the tokens are available, those holders can decide whether to sell any of them.

title: Nexus: Unlocks 1,116.67 Billion NEX for Investors and Team - Nov 2027
